description: This file defines the EmployeeActionSummaryService class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, responsible for managing employee action summary data. It includes a private DAO property and a getter method to instantiate or retrieve this DAO.

classes.name: EmployeeActionSummaryService
classes.description: Service class providing access to employee action summary data, encapsulating a DAO for data operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeActionSummaryDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object for employee action summaries, instantiating it if not already created.
